question: For weekly-sales data, I need an analysis of our sales performance around mid-June for the years 2018, 2019, and 2020. Specifically, calculate the percentage change in sales between the four weeks leading up to June 15 and the four weeks following June 15 for each year.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    calendar_year,
    week_date,
    sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
    AND (
      (calendar_year = 2018 AND week_date IN ('2018-05-21','2018-05-28','2018-06-04','2018-06-11','2018-06-18','2018-06-25','2018-07-02','2018-07-09'))
      OR (calendar_year = 2019 AND week_date IN ('2019-05-20','2019-05-27','2019-06-03','2019-06-10','2019-06-17','2019-06-24','2019-07-01','2019-07-08'))
      OR (calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date IN ('2020-05-18','2020-05-25','2020-06-01','2020-06-08','2020-06-15','2020-06-22','2020-06-29','2020-07-06'))
    )
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    calendar_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN week_date < '2018-06-15' AND calendar_year = 2018 THEN sales ELSE 0 END)
      + SUM(CASE WHEN week_date < '2019-06-15' AND calendar_year = 2019 THEN sales ELSE 0 END)
      + SUM(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' AND calendar_year = 2020 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) AS before_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN week_date >= '2018-06-15' AND calendar_year = 2018 THEN sales ELSE 0 END)
      + SUM(CASE WHEN week_date >= '2019-06-15' AND calendar_year = 2019 THEN sales ELSE 0 END)
      + SUM(CASE WHEN week_date >= '2020-06-15' AND calendar_year = 2020 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) AS after_sales
  FROM base
  GROUP BY calendar_year
)
SELECT
  calendar_year,
  (after_sales - before_sales) * 100.0 / before_sales AS percentage_change
FROM agg
ORDER BY calendar_year

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    calendar_year,
    week_date,
    sales,
    CASE WHEN week_date < '06-15' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE calendar_year IN (2018,2019,2020)
    AND (
      (calendar_year=2018 AND week_date IN ('2018-05-21','2018-05-28','2018-06-04','2018-06-11','2018-06-18','2018-06-25','2018-07-02','2018-07-09'))
      OR (calendar_year=2019 AND week_date IN ('2019-05-20','2019-05-27','2019-06-03','2019-06-10','2019-06-17','2019-06-24','2019-07-01','2019-07-08'))
      OR (calendar_year=2020 AND week_date IN ('2020-05-18','2020-05-25','2020-06-01','2020-06-08','2020-06-15','2020-06-22','2020-06-29','2020-07-06'))
    )
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    calendar_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period='before' THEN sales ELSE 0 END) AS before_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period='after' THEN sales ELSE 0 END) AS after_sales
  FROM base
  GROUP BY calendar_year
)
SELECT
  calendar_year,
  (after_sales - before_sales) * 100.0 / before_sales AS pct_change
FROM agg
ORDER BY calendar_year;
